Name: Personal Trees
Author: Reprodudix
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/yn82jbfD/personal-trees-1.png[/img][/center]
This mod adds a tree ownership system: planted trees automatically belong to the player who planted them, protecting them from other players. You can also claim unowned trees or release your own trees for shared wood farming. Owner portraits and tooltips make ownership easy to identify.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Optional: Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure the mod. You can also edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] in the mod's folder after the first launch.[/*]
[*]For multiplayer, install Personal Trees on the host and all clients.[/*]
[*]Run the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][b]Tree Ownership System[/b]
Trees planted by a player automatically belong to them. Only the owner can chop down an owned tree.
[/*]
[*][b]Wild Trees Remain Free[/b]
Naturally grown trees start unowned and can be chopped down by anyone until claimed.
[/*]
[*][b]Toggle Tree Ownership[/b]
Stand next to a tree, point at its base, and press [b]K[/b] to claim an unowned tree or release your own tree. Released trees become available for anyone to chop — useful for shared wood farming areas!

You cannot change another player's tree ownership. The keybind is configurable via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] or [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]. In multiplayer, ownership changes are validated by the host.
[/*]
[*][b]Ownership Notification[/b]
If a non-owner attempts to chop down an owned tree, a message will identify its owner.
[/*]
[*][b]Hover to See Owner[/b]
Place the cursor over the lower part of an owned tree to see a tooltip with the owner's name.
[/*]
[*][b]Mini Owner Portrait[/b]
A small portrait of the tree's owner appears on the trunk of owned trees.
[/*]
[*][b]Toggle Owner Portraits[/b]
Use the configurable keybind ([b]J[/b] by default) to show or hide owner portraits. This only changes portrait visibility — it does not change ownership. Configurable via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] or [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].
[/*]
[*][b]Missing Mod Notification[/b]
If a player joins a multiplayer session without the mod, a chat message will inform others.
[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Works with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].[/*]
[*]Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.[/*]
[*]For multiplayer protection and ownership controls, the host and all clients must have Personal Trees installed.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: - Added configurable tree ownership toggle (K by default). Players can now claim unowned trees or release their own trees for shared wood farming.

Manifest.Name: Personal Trees
Manifest.Description: Displays tree ownership and prevents non-owners from cutting them down.
